sentences.text: For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Ramesh Jha, Advocate

For the NHAI : Dr. Maurya Vijay Chandra, Advocate  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 08-08-2024 Heard the parties.
2. At the outset, learned advocate for the petitioner seeks permission to make necessary correction in the cause title of the respondent.
4. Let necessary correction must be done in course of the day.

5. The grievance of the petitioner is confined to the determination and payment of the amount of compensation in terms of Section 3G of the National Highways Act, 1956 with respect to acquisition of the land of the petitioner in connection with construction/widening of the four lane of Patna-Gaya- Dobhi road of NH83.
6.

Let a counter affidavit be filed on behalf of respondent No.3 bringing on record with regard to the present Patna High Court CWJC No.7318 of 2018(2) dt.08-08-2024 factual position regarding the payment of compensation to the land holders.

(Harish Kumar, J) durgesh/-
